about: Design values used by the v16 product boards, mapped to the tokens that already exist in apps/web-next/app/globals.css. Use the existing token wherever one is named. New tokens are listed with a suggested name and a dark value, and the bridge in components/mantine/theme.ts must learn every new one. Contrast figures are WCAG ratios computed from the oklch values. The shopper widgets never use these tokens: they take the merchant's theme, see storefront below. The Shopify admin pages use Polaris, see shopifyAdmin below.

font.numbers: font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums on every figure in tables, tiles, meters and charts

foreground.use: text, primary buttons, active nav item, chart ink, switch on
foreground.contrast: 14.20 on background, 15.66 on panel, 12.57 on muted

card.use: sidebar, inner wells inside cards, source chips, KPI tiles inside a card

panel.use: every raised card and dialog on the dashboard, the selected segment of tabs and segmented controls, secondary buttons

muted.use: tab and segmented tracks, meter tracks, row hover, avatar discs

mutedText.contrast: the repo token gives 5.11 on background, 5.43 on card, 5.64 on panel and 4.53 on muted, so it passes AA everywhere the boards use it; keep it and avoid muted text on the muted fill where you can

border.use: card borders, row dividers, input borders, chart gridlines

success.use: Active and On badges, Passes, Added, the health dot, positive change
success.contrast: 4.76 on success-soft, 5.32 on panel; white on it 5.67

attention.use: Runs out soon, waiting shoppers, flagged products, the run-out point on the usage chart
attention.contrast: 5.18 on attention-soft, 5.80 on panel; white on it 6.18

attentionSoft.use: attention badge and panel fill, the no try-on band on the usage chart at 55% opacity

info.use: neutral information rows, the product row on Today

ai.use: anything the assistant drafted or suggested: suggested replies, drafted answers, recommendations, Ask GrindCTRL

danger.use: Something broke on Today-States, failed checks

alert.use: unread counts on Inbox and the bell dot only
alert.contrast: white text 4.89. Do not use the brighter oklch(0.62 0.15 55), white on it is 3.83

onPrimary.use: text on primary buttons, the save bar and the active nav item

focus.useToken: the repo's existing focus ring if it matches, else outline with --foreground

type.eyebrow: 12px, weight 700, letter-spacing 0.06em, uppercase in English only via CSS, never in Arabic
type.minimum: 12px for any text; 11.5px only for tiny badges inside images

radius.pill: 999px for buttons, chips, tabs, badges and the save bar's buttons
radius.note: The repo's --radius is 10px. Map these through theme.ts rather than hard coding them.

layout.sidebar: 248px, sticky, border on the inline end
layout.phone: under 900px the sidebar is replaced by a bottom tab bar (Owner-Phone) and main padding becomes 14px 14px 80px
layout.controls: buttons, chips and tabs 40px high, inputs 44px, nothing tappable under 40 by 40
layout.savebar: sticky 12px from the top, ink background, radius 18px

motion.rise: opacity 0 to 1 and 6px up, 300ms, for confirmations and drawers
motion.livePulse: opacity pulse on the live dot, 2s
motion.reduced: prefers-reduced-motion removes every animation and transition

dataviz.bars: one hue (foreground), 4px radius on the data end only
dataviz.lines: 2px foreground; dashed only for a projection
dataviz.area: foreground at 8% opacity under the used line
dataviz.grid: solid hairlines in the border colour
dataviz.legend: shown whenever a chart has two or more series
dataviz.labels: direct labels on key points (Today, run-out); axis text in muted text, tabular numbers
dataviz.tooltips: native title per day for now, plus role=img and a desc that states the takeaway
dataviz.phone: under 640px the usage chart becomes a meter with the same takeaway

storefront.about: Both shopper widgets render inside our iframes and take their look from the merchant's theme through the loader's probe (see 07-board-map.md). These are the variables the iframes read, with the defaults the boards use for the fictional store. GrindCTRL colours, fonts and branding never appear here.

--sf-font.default: theme body font, else system-ui, -apple-system, Segoe UI, Roboto, sans-serif

--sf-font-arabic.default: theme Arabic font if the theme has one, else IBM Plex Sans Arabic shipped with the widget

--sf-muted.default: ink at 62% over the background, checked for 4.5:1

--sf-accent.default: the Add to cart button's background

--sf-on-accent.default: the Add to cart button's text colour, else white or ink, whichever passes 4.5:1

--sf-radius.default: the Add to cart button's border radius

fixed.dialog: centred dialog on desktop, 1040 by 716px on a 1440 by 900 screen, radius 26px, photo column 500px; keep 24px from the viewport edges on smaller screens
fixed.targets: 44px minimum; primary sheet button 54px; secondary actions 48px
fixed.imageChips: white at 90% with #3d3a36 text over photos (AI preview, Not right?)
fixed.aiLabel: every look and every assistant message carries a visible AI label
fixed.motion: look reveal 700ms cubic-bezier(.2,.8,.2,1) from 8px blur and 1.03 scale; spinner 900ms; none under reduced motion

shopifyAdmin.about: The six Shopify boards are drawn in the Polaris look so the embedded app feels native. If the owner approves Polaris (phase zero item 28), build them with Polaris web components and App Bridge and take every value from Polaris, not from these numbers. The values below are only what the boards used to imitate it.

mapping.banner: s-banner, one at a time, tone critical, warning, info or success
mapping.badge: s-badge tones success, attention (warning), info, critical
mapping.button: s-button, 32px; variant primary for the one main action
mapping.saveBar: App Bridge contextual save bar (ui-save-bar) on editors
mapping.nav: App Bridge ui-nav-menu: home, Try-On, Store Chat, Plans
mapping.type: Inter 13px/20px body, 20px/24px page title, 14px/20px card title; Arabic falls back to IBM Plex Sans Arabic
